description: ModX: an input expander that adds randomness, repeats and glide to a Phi or Spike sequence, a channel to a step; it goes to the left of that module

params.text: Sets how long a repeat lasts as a share of its slot, 0 to 100%
Sets how long the glide lasts as a share of the step, 0 to 100%
Sets the shape of the glide, from logarithmic through linear to exponential

inputs.text: Sets the chance per step: on Phi, that the step plays a value picked at random from the buffer; on Spike, that a gate that was high comes out low
Sets the number of repeats per step, one step being 10/16 of a volt: Phi sends that many step triggers, Spike divides the gate into that many
Sets the glide per step: on Phi, a glide from the last value to this one; on Spike, a gate forced to a full step, ignoring duration, delay and any transformation

notes: this module is placed to the left of the Phi or Spike module it modifies, or beside another connected input expander on that side
each of the three inputs is read a channel to a step, so a polyphonic cable gives every step its own value
an Arr module makes the repeat counts easier to dial in, since one step is 10/16 of a volt
